text: Did you know that if you add peanut butter to chickpeas,
mix in a little honey, vanilla extract, and baking powder,
Stir in dark chocolate chips, scoop into small cookies,
You just made chickpea cookies that are healthy,
high in protein, and made without refined sugar or flour.
These cookies feed the good bacteria in your gut,
keep you full for hours, and steady your blood sugar
so the sugar cravings fade away.
I make healthy weight loss recipes like this every day.
If you wanna see the simple routine I give to my clients
to support their gut health and bloating,
comment yes, and make sure you follow me
so I can send it to you.
